result.detail: Hidden assumptions to check at review. (1) The DEPTH >= 2 precondition is not enforced in the RTL. (2) For a DEPTH that is not a power of two, rd_data indexes mem with a pointer that never exceeds LAST, so no out-of-range read occurs. (3) Storage is not reset, as the microarchitecture specifies; rd_data is undefined while empty, so the testbench checks rd_data only when the model is non-empty. Both files carry `timescale 1ns/1ps so Verilator does not raise TIMESCALEMOD. The mutation test (sync_fifo_tb_fail.v) and the .sby proofs are left for a follow-on task; see the deviation record.
